typography.instructions: Import Cabinet Grotesk from Fontshare (https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700,400,900&display=swap) and Outfit from Google Fonts. Use tracking-tight on all large headings (H1, H2).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-20 to py-32 for main sections. Use large gaps (gap-6 or gap-8).
spacing_and_layout.services_grid: Bento 'Tetris' grid. Mix squares and talls. Avoid generic 3-column equal heights. Use col-span-2 or row-span-2 intentionally to create asymmetry.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Solid background (#FFFFFF or #E2F1E8) with 1px border (border-black/5). No muddy drop shadows. Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl.
surfaces_and_components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism. bg-[#FAF9F6]/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-black/5. MUST be sticky with z-50. Include logo, links, and Phone Call CTA.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Primary CTA (Quote): background accent (#CCF081) with foreground text (#0F241C). Secondary (Call): background primary (#183629) with white text. Apply hover:scale-105 transition-transform.
surfaces_and_components.inputs: Use customized Shadcn inputs: rounded-xl, bg-white, 1px border-[#183629]/20, focus:ring-[#CCF081].
surfaces_and_components.icons: Use lucide-react. Standardize stroke-width to 1.5 for elegance.

hero_background.description: A bright living room filled with furniture and large windows. Use for Hero or About background.

gallery.description: Eco-friendly spray bottles on a table

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure any text over images uses a dark/light gradient overlay for readability to meet APCA contrast standards.

specific_section_instructions.hero: Bold H1 (e.g., text-5xl md:text-7xl tracking-tighter). The image can sit in a massive rounded container alongside or underneath the text. Do not cover the entire screen with a muddy overlay.
specific_section_instructions.stats: Display stats (2000+ clients, 15+ years, 5.0 rating) with large typography (text-5xl+) in the primary color (#183629).
specific_section_instructions.services_bento: List the services (Home, Recurring, Move-out/in, Deep cleaning, Commercial, Airbnb, Post-construction, Eco-friendly). Make 'Deep cleaning' or 'Eco-friendly' span larger blocks for visual hierarchy.
specific_section_instructions.why_choose_us: Present as clean list items or small cards with Lucide icons (Shield, Leaf, Clock, Sparkles).
specific_section_instructions.quote_form: Build a comprehensive lead form (name, phone, email, service type, address, message). Place it cleanly inside a rounded-3xl card with #FFFFFF bg.
specific_section_instructions.footer: Reverse the contrast. Make the footer background #0F241C and text #FAF9F6. Very large padding (py-24).
